observations.scene: Recognizable same candlelit goldsmith workshop: tall ivory candle left, small candle on right rear bench, dark timber and warm rough stone, cool blue diamond-lattice window, used bench and tools.

observations.center: Real continuous bench surface, stone/timber, standing tools, steel block, punch/hammer forms and stool/rear bench occupy the middle; no empty necklace-shaped cutout or blank void.
observations.surface: Photographic wax, worn wood, stone and metal; no definite procedural wood-pattern or retouch seam observed.
observations.iphoneCrop: Both entire candle flames and bodies remain visible with workshop details.
